description: Generated Saksarkivtjeneste API client (v2 and v3) with dependency injection, resilience and health check support.
releaseNotes:
# Changelog

All notable changes to `Arbeidstilsynet.Saksarkiv.Client` are documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and this project
adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html). While on `0.x`, minor
versions may contain breaking changes.

Every released version must have a `## <version>` heading matching `<Version>` in
`Saksarkiv.Client.csproj`; CI fails otherwise.

## 0.5.1

### Changed

- Updated Microsoft.Kiota.Bundle to 2.2.0.

## 0.5.0

### Changed

- Remove various fields from QueueMelding
- Rename MeldingStatus to MeldingInfo
- Rename MeldingStatusType to MeldingStatus
- Rename EksternId to SekvensId in MeldingInfo

## 0.4.1

### Changed

- The v3 `Personnummer` fields now document and validate support for D-numbers.

## 0.4.0

### Changed

- **Breaking:** In the v3 API, `PersonInfo` on journalposter is renamed to `KorrespondansePart`
  (Noark 5 term). `OpprettJournalpostRequest.PersonInfo` is now `KorrespondansePart` of type
  `OpprettJournalpostRequestKorrespondansePart`, and `HentSakResponseJournalpost.PersonInfo` is now
  `KorrespondansePart` of type `HentSakResponseKorrespondansePart`.

## 0.3.1

### Changed

- Regenerated the v2 and v3 client specifications with OpenAPI 3.1.2. The HTTP API is unchanged.

## 0.3.0

### Changed

- **Breaking:** `MeldingId` is now a Guid wherever applicable, and `MeldingStatus.Fullfort` has been
  renamed to `MeldingStatus.SistEndret`

## 0.2.0

### Changed

- **Breaking:** The v2 models `AvskrivRestanseRequest`, `AvskrivRestanseForBrukerRequest` and
  `HentSaksarkivKorrespondanselisteParams` moved from
  `Arbeidstilsynet.Saksarkiv.Client.V2.Models.AT.EArkiv.RestApi` to
  `Arbeidstilsynet.Saksarkiv.Client.V2.Models.AT.EArkiv.RestApi.V2`. The HTTP API is unchanged.

## 0.1.1

### Changed

- Updated Microsoft.Extensions dependency packages to 10.0.15.

## 0.1.0

First version, replacing `Arbeidstilsynet.Common.Saksarkiv` (from
[dotnet-common](https://github.com/Arbeidstilsynet/dotnet-common)), now published from this
repository.

### Added

- `SaksarkivClientV3` in `Arbeidstilsynet.Saksarkiv.Client.V3`, generated for API v3.
- `OpprettSakAsync(...)` extension and `SaksarkivFile` for creating a case with files over v3.
  It throws `ArgumentException` if two files have the same `FileName`.
- `AddSaksarkivClientV3(...)`.
- The OpenAPI documents (`openApiV2.json`, `openApiV3.json`) are included in the package.

### Changed

- Package renamed from `Arbeidstilsynet.Common.Saksarkiv` to `Arbeidstilsynet.Saksarkiv.Client`,
  and the root namespace from `Arbeidstilsynet.Common.Saksarkiv` to
  `Arbeidstilsynet.Saksarkiv.Client`.
- The v2 client is renamed from `SaksarkivClient` to `SaksarkivClientV2` and moved to
  `Arbeidstilsynet.Saksarkiv.Client.V2`. Register it with `AddSaksarkivClientV2(...)` (previously
  `AddSaksarkivClient(...)`).
- The clients are generated at build time from the OpenAPI documents produced by
  Saksarkivtjeneste, instead of a copy of the document. For v2 this means:
  - Model namespaces gained an `AT.EArkiv` segment, e.g. `V2.Models.AT.EArkiv.Entiteter.Meldinger`
    (previously `Models.Entiteter.Meldinger`).
  - `Apiv2.Sak.Validersaksnummer` is split into `ValiderSaksnummer` (`POST`) and
    `ValidersaksnummerEscaped` (`GET`).
  - `Apiv2.Saker.FinnMedReferanser` accepts the `KunUtgaatteSaker` query parameter.
  - `Apiv2.Health.ArkivStatus` and `Api.Health.Ping`/`AuthPing` are available.
- Unsafe HTTP methods (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `CONNECT`) are no longer retried.
  Previously only `POST` was excluded.
- Retries for the health probe are also skipped when the request fails with an exception.
- The `Saksarkiv` health check is registered by both `AddSaksarkivClientV2(...)` and
  `AddSaksarkivClientV3(...)`, and only once when both are called.
- The access token is only sent to the configured `BaseUrl` origin (scheme, host and port).
  Requests to another origin, for example via Kiota's `WithUrl(...)`, throw
  `InvalidOperationException`.
- Targets `net10.0` only (previously also `net8.0`).
